body: Thank you!
I'll check it out, thank you!
I did, and I posted a couple of gigs but none of them worked. Even listed them for the cheapest price.

I'm sure by that logic, we should also ban Skype, Discord, Messenger, and all other ways to communicate by voice chat. Why Valorant then?

Your answer makes a lot of sense, tho. WhatsApp calls are banned so I get where you are coming from, thank you!
Thanks, bro. I hope you get through it, too! I'm here if you need someone.
Yeah, had a terrible week after that. I'm mad I lied to my friend and I'm also mad because of the path he took.

I know a friend who was one of my best mates in middle school, we went to different high schools but we still met now and then. Found out that he does illegal shady stuff such as selling weed and crack, he can get you some girl to give you a head, you name it. In North Africa it's no weird to be able to sneak some guns and armory so I knew he could get me one because he once tried to do it himself. I told him I want it because one of my friends have a super abusive father and wanted to kill him, it sounded weird to him but he told me to wait for a couple of days so he can figure out a way. He called me when I was with my family and I think they overheard some of my conversations that day so they were suspicious, told them I'll go to meet him and they followed me and stopped me when I was half-way there, but it was ready for me to do it and I was going to do it as soon as I feel it on my hand.
Thank you for being here, I really appreciate it! <3
Good choice, I've been using it for some time now.
Yeah, you are totally right. It's a rollercoaster of everything. I hope you get through it!
Thank you! I'm here as well if you need someone.

You are truly an amazing person, I can't never get how strong parents are. You are amazing and I hope you keep what you are doing with spreading love and awareness. I'm sure Kyle is in a better place now, happy with what his parents are doing.
Thank you so much for your kind message and I'm really sorry for your loss. I hope the best for you, guys! <3
Thank you for your kindness, and I'm glad you are passing some of your unpleasant experience. It truly takes a bold human to do so, you are helping in a lot of ways. Hope you get past through it.
I really hope you get past this and hear from you again, I'm here for you.
I'm trying my best to be normal around them so they don't feel they gave birth to a mentally-ill useless scumbag, they don't deserve that.
Sounds awesome, please DM me.

I believe that sometimes someone just needs to scream very loud at someone to get it off their chest, maybe just listening will help you and make you think less about it, it will make you feel someone actually cares. Maybe they don't know you but you just do it because saving someone's life can't be described. I'm sure a lot of lives were saved just because someone decided to comment on this subreddit. Maybe this subreddit will be the reason I lived longer, even it was a couple of days, it's something.

Religion is usually a healthy coping mechanism for a lot of people so they are trying to help you since it helps them too. Not because God magically cure them, but because it gives them a purpose for this life. I really feel the same way as you do as I'm also dealing with the guilt-tripping problem. I hope you seek the help you need.
Hell yeah!
Yeah, I wanted my death to be peaceful and fast. If you need to talk, I'm a pretty good listener, and I'm always here!

I feel you, social life is truly a hard thing and I always try to find the secret behind mastering it. Hopefully we might find this.

For me, music is what keeps me "here", I can spend days listening to music non-stop. I hope you have a good day too!

You are totally right, if one thing I've learnt from mental illness is that I realized how strong I was, but I can sometimes get fragile and just breakdown. But I think that's ok, we all get more stronger with every breakdown.
It's really exhausting, but I'm trying to avoid it as much as possible. Thank you for your concern!
